header.name: Move Inventory
header.description: Use this flow to change the location of inventory by inventoryId.

version.description: Cleaned up the flow and removed unused nodes.

eb9a5b84-4231-459f-bf31-735b1fdb88f5.name: Validate Input
eb9a5b84-4231-459f-bf31-735b1fdb88f5.note: Pass in a locationId and either an inventoryId or a handlingUnitId.

c5f65f87-071e-4305-bf51-ff801c1f49aa.name: Prepare Payload
c5f65f87-071e-4305-bf51-ff801c1f49aa.note:
This node goes through to find first where a serial number has an available quantity > 0 and then the following:

- sourceInventoryBarcode -> the inventory serial that is being moved to a storage unit
- destinationInventoryBarcode -> the newest created at inventory that is found at the move to location

These will then be merged together to form 1 inventory.serialNumber at the storage unit.
